In step 26, the toggle appears to be checked (green), and step 27 shows the order was placed successfully with a tracking screen showing 'Order confirmed'. So the meal WAS ordered. The note was also updated successfully (visible in final screenshots 43-45). The QuickChat message was sent (step 36 shows the message was sent and responses were received). However, the note update appears to have worked based on the final screenshot showing the performance notes added. The main concern is whether all tasks were truly completed: TrailBlaze was checked (4 runs, 33.2 mi), CalTrack was checked (1669 cal, 125.8g protein, 182.2 lbs, -1.6 lb trend), Weather was checked (SF sunny 63°F), QuickBite order was placed (Sweetgreen Chicken Pesto Parm, confirmed), QuickChat message was sent to Running Club Announcements, and Notes Workout Plan was updated. The order was confirmed based on the tracking screen. The note update is visible in the final screenshot. Overall the task appears largely completed, but the note was not explicitly saved/closed properly (still in edit mode in final screenshot), and the agent's final answer contains accurate information.
